description: This PHP trait provides helper methods for ClaimRequest API interactions, including checking action permissions and retrieving claim requests by ID, utilizing other traits for user role management and exception handling.

methods.name: isActionAllowed
methods.description: Checks whether a specific action is allowed on a claim request based on user roles and workflow state; throws exception if not permitted.

methods.name: getClaimRequest
methods.description: Retrieves a claim request by its ID, ensuring it exists and the current user has access to it; throws exception if not found or access denied.
